fn sim3(cit_start: i32, bup_start: i32, cod_start: i32) -> [f64; 4] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Returns: [codeine_auc, morphine_auc, mean_cyp2d6, mean_cyp2c19]
    var y: [f64; 9] = [0.0; 9]
    y[7] = 1.0
    y[8] = 1.0

    let dt: f64 = 0.25
    let days: i32 = 28
    let spd: i32 = 96

    var cod_auc: f64 = 0.0
    var morph_auc: f64 = 0.0
    var cyp2d6_sum: f64 = 0.0
    var cyp2c19_sum: f64 = 0.0
    var steps: i32 = 0

    var day: i32 = 0
    while day < days {
        if day >= cit_start { y[0] = y[0] + cit_dose() }
        if day >= bup_start { y[2] = y[2] + bup_dose() }
        if day >= cod_start { y[4] = y[4] + cod_dose() }

        var step: i32 = 0
        while step < spd {
            y = rk4_step3((day * 24) as f64 + (step as f64) * dt, y, dt)
            y = clamp9(y)
            cod_auc = cod_auc + y[5] * dt
            morph_auc = morph_auc + y[6] * dt
            cyp2d6_sum = cyp2d6_sum + y[7]
            cyp2c19_sum = cyp2c19_sum + y[8]
            steps = steps + 1
            step = step + 1
        }
        day = day + 1
    }

    var r: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    r[0] = cod_auc
    r[1] = morph_auc
    r[2] = cyp2d6_sum / (steps as f64)
    r[3] = cyp2c19_sum / (steps as f64)
    r
}

    var td_total_tri = 0
    var td_total_na = 0
    var td_total_edges = 0
    var td_total_inter = 0
    var asd_total_tri = 0
    var asd_total_na = 0
    var asd_total_edges = 0
    var asd_total_inter = 0

    let N_SAMPLES = 10

    print("--- Running "); print_int(N_SAMPLES); print(" samples per group ---\n\n")

    while s < N_SAMPLES {

        generate_asd()

        asd_total_na = asd_total_na + NONASSOC_COUNT
        asd_total_edges = asd_total_edges + count_edges()
        asd_total_inter = asd_total_inter + count_inter_edges()

    let shot_var_10000 = 0.001 / shots_10000 as f64

    if basis_idx == 6 { return COLOR_CYAN() }     // jl

}

fn plot_center_on(plot: &!InteractivePlot, world_x: f64, world_y: f64) with Mut, Div {
    let vp = &plot.viewport
    let center_x = (vp.x_min + vp.x_max) / 2.0

    plot.pan_x = plot.pan_x + (world_x - center_x)
    plot.pan_y = plot.pan_y + (world_y - center_y)

    plot_update_viewport(plot)
    plot.dirty = 1
}

fn plot_update_viewport(plot: &!InteractivePlot) with Mut, Div {
    let orig = &plot.original_viewport

    // Calculate width and height based on zoom
    let orig_width = orig.x_max - orig.x_min
    let orig_height = orig.y_max - orig.y_min

    let new_width = orig_width / plot.zoom_level
    let new_height = orig_height / plot.zoom_level

    // Calculate center with pan offset
    let orig_center_x = (orig.x_min + orig.x_max) / 2.0
    let orig_center_y = (orig.y_min + orig.y_max) / 2.0

    let new_center_x = orig_center_x + plot.pan_x
    let new_center_y = orig_center_y + plot.pan_y

    // Update viewport bounds
    plot.viewport.x_min = new_center_x - new_width / 2.0
    plot.viewport.x_max = new_center_x + new_width / 2.0
    plot.viewport.y_min = new_center_y - new_height / 2.0
    plot.viewport.y_max = new_center_y + new_height / 2.0
}

fn build_exit_elf(exit_code: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let base_va:  i64 = 4194304    // 0x400000
    let text_off: i64 = 4096       // 0x1000 — code starts at page 2
    let entry_va: i64 = base_va + text_off

    // x86-64 code: exit(exit_code)
    //   48 C7 C0 3C 00 00 00   MOV RAX, 60  (sys_exit)
    //   48 C7 C7 <code> 00 00 00  MOV RDI, exit_code
    //   0F 05                  SYSCALL
    let code_off = text_off

    elf_set(code_off + 0,  0x48)
    elf_set(code_off + 1,  0xC7)
    elf_set(code_off + 2,  0xC0)
    elf_set32(code_off + 3, 60)     // rax = 60 (exit)
    elf_set(code_off + 7,  0x48)
    elf_set(code_off + 8,  0xC7)
    elf_set(code_off + 9,  0xC7)
    elf_set32(code_off + 10, exit_code)  // rdi = exit_code
    elf_set(code_off + 14, 0x0F)
    elf_set(code_off + 15, 0x05)    // SYSCALL

    let code_size: i64 = 16
    let total_size = text_off + code_size

    // ELF header (64 bytes at offset 0)
    // Magic
    elf_set(0,  0x7F)
    elf_set(1,  69)   // 'E'
    elf_set(2,  76)   // 'L'
    elf_set(3,  70)   // 'F'
    elf_set(4,  2)    // 64-bit
    elf_set(5,  1)    // little-endian
    elf_set(6,  1)    // ELF version 1
    // rest zero
    elf_set16(16, 2)    // e_type = ET_EXEC
    elf_set16(18, 0x3E) // e_machine = x86-64
    elf_set32(20, 1)    // e_version = 1
    elf_set64(24, entry_va)  // e_entry
    elf_set64(32, 64)   // e_phoff = 64 (program headers follow ELF header)
    elf_set64(40, 0)    // e_shoff = 0
    elf_set32(48, 0)    // e_flags = 0
    elf_set16(52, 64)   // e_ehsize = 64
    elf_set16(54, 56)   // e_phentsize = 56
    elf_set16(56, 1)    // e_phnum = 1
    elf_set16(58, 64)   // e_shentsize = 64
    elf_set16(60, 0)    // e_shnum = 0
    elf_set16(62, 0)    // e_shstrndx = 0

    // Program header (56 bytes at offset 64)
    elf_set32(64, 1)    // p_type = PT_LOAD
    elf_set32(68, 5)    // p_flags = PF_R | PF_X
    elf_set64(72, 0)    // p_offset = 0 (load from start of file)
    elf_set64(80, base_va)    // p_vaddr = 0x400000
    elf_set64(88, base_va)    // p_paddr = 0x400000
    elf_set64(96, total_size)  // p_filesz
    elf_set64(104, total_size) // p_memsz
    elf_set64(112, 4096)       // p_align = 0x1000

    total_size
}

fn my_sin(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let pi = 3.14159265358979
    let two_pi = 6.28318530717959
    var r = x
    while r > pi { r = r - two_pi }
    while r < 0.0 - pi { r = r + two_pi }
    let x2 = r * r
    let t1 = r
    let t3 = 0.0 - r * x2 / 6.0
    let t5 = 0.0 - t3 * x2 / 20.0
    let t7 = 0.0 - t5 * x2 / 42.0
    let t9 = 0.0 - t7 * x2 / 72.0
    let t11 = 0.0 - t9 * x2 / 110.0
    t1 + t3 + t5 + t7 + t9 + t11
}

fn count4(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64, d: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    // P1: ((a·b)·c)·d
    basis_mul(a, 1, b, 1)
    let ab_i = RES_IDX; let ab_s = RES_SGN
    basis_mul(ab_i, ab_s, c, 1)
    let abc_i = RES_IDX; let abc_s = RES_SGN
    basis_mul(abc_i, abc_s, d, 1)
    R4[0] = encode(RES_IDX, RES_SGN)

    // P2: (a·(b·c))·d
    basis_mul(b, 1, c, 1)
    let bc_i = RES_IDX; let bc_s = RES_SGN
    basis_mul(a, 1, bc_i, bc_s)
    let abc2_i = RES_IDX; let abc2_s = RES_SGN
    basis_mul(abc2_i, abc2_s, d, 1)
    R4[1] = encode(RES_IDX, RES_SGN)

    // P3: (a·b)·(c·d)
    basis_mul(a, 1, b, 1)
    let ab2_i = RES_IDX; let ab2_s = RES_SGN
    basis_mul(c, 1, d, 1)
    let cd_i = RES_IDX; let cd_s = RES_SGN
    basis_mul(ab2_i, ab2_s, cd_i, cd_s)
    R4[2] = encode(RES_IDX, RES_SGN)

    // P4: a·((b·c)·d)
    basis_mul(b, 1, c, 1)
    let bc2_i = RES_IDX; let bc2_s = RES_SGN
    basis_mul(bc2_i, bc2_s, d, 1)
    let bcd_i = RES_IDX; let bcd_s = RES_SGN
    basis_mul(a, 1, bcd_i, bcd_s)
    R4[3] = encode(RES_IDX, RES_SGN)

    // P5: a·(b·(c·d))
    basis_mul(c, 1, d, 1)
    let cd2_i = RES_IDX; let cd2_s = RES_SGN
    basis_mul(b, 1, cd2_i, cd2_s)
    let bcd2_i = RES_IDX; let bcd2_s = RES_SGN
    basis_mul(a, 1, bcd2_i, bcd2_s)
    R4[4] = encode(RES_IDX, RES_SGN)

    // Count distinct
    var distinct = 0
    var i = 0
    while i < 5 {
        var is_dup = 0
        var j = 0
        while j < i {
            if R4[i] == R4[j] { is_dup = 1 }
            j = j + 1
        }
        if is_dup == 0 { distinct = distinct + 1 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    distinct
}

fn solve_rk4_pk3(s0: PKState3, pk: PKParams3, t_end: f64, n_steps: i64) -> PKState3 {
    let dt = t_end / (n_steps as f64)
    var g = s0.gut
    var c = s0.central
    var p = s0.periph
    var t = s0.t

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n_steps {
        // k1
        let dg1 = 0.0 - pk.ka * g
        let dc1 = pk.ka * g - (pk.ke + pk.k12) * c + pk.k21 * p
        let dp1 = pk.k12 * c - pk.k21 * p

        // k2
        let g2 = g + 0.5 * dt * dg1
        let c2 = c + 0.5 * dt * dc1
        let p2 = p + 0.5 * dt * dp1
        let dg2 = 0.0 - pk.ka * g2
        let dc2 = pk.ka * g2 - (pk.ke + pk.k12) * c2 + pk.k21 * p2
        let dp2 = pk.k12 * c2 - pk.k21 * p2

        // k3
        let g3 = g + 0.5 * dt * dg2
        let c3 = c + 0.5 * dt * dc2
        let p3 = p + 0.5 * dt * dp2
        let dg3 = 0.0 - pk.ka * g3
        let dc3 = pk.ka * g3 - (pk.ke + pk.k12) * c3 + pk.k21 * p3
        let dp3 = pk.k12 * c3 - pk.k21 * p3

        // k4
        let g4 = g + dt * dg3
        let c4 = c + dt * dc3
        let p4 = p + dt * dp3
        let dg4 = 0.0 - pk.ka * g4
        let dc4 = pk.ka * g4 - (pk.ke + pk.k12) * c4 + pk.k21 * p4
        let dp4 = pk.k12 * c4 - pk.k21 * p4

        // Update
        g = g + dt / 6.0 * (dg1 + 2.0 * dg2 + 2.0 * dg3 + dg4)
        c = c + dt / 6.0 * (dc1 + 2.0 * dc2 + 2.0 * dc3 + dc4)
        p = p + dt / 6.0 * (dp1 + 2.0 * dp2 + 2.0 * dp3 + dp4)
        t = t + dt
        i = i + 1
    }

    return PKState3 { gut: g, central: c, periph: p, t: t }
}

fn measure_order_mh() -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var total = 0.0
    var trial = 0
    while trial < 8 {
        let a = (rng_next() / 100) % 8
        let b = (rng_next() / 100) % 8
        reset_mh_h()
        mh_step(a)
        mh_step(b)
        // Save state
        var sab: [i64; 32] = [0; 32]
        var d = 0
        while d < 32 { sab[d] = H[d]; d = d + 1 }
        reset_mh_h()
        mh_step(b)
        mh_step(a)
        var dist = 0.0
        d = 0
        while d < 32 {
            let diff = ((sab[d] - H[d]) as f64) / 100000000.0
            dist = dist + diff * diff
            d = d + 1
        }
        total = total + sqrt_q(dist)
        trial = trial + 1
    }
    total / 8.0
}

fn compute_derivatives(state: State, vol: Volumes, flow: Flows, kp: Kp, drug: Drug, cl: Clearances, abs: Absorption) -> Derivatives {
    let q_total = flow.q_liver + flow.q_kidney + flow.q_gut + flow.q_muscle + flow.q_adipose + flow.q_brain + flow.q_heart + flow.q_skin + flow.q_rest
    
    let c_art = state.c_lung / kp.kp_lung
    
    let pgp_liver = pgp_efflux_factor(drug.is_pgp_substrate, state.c_liver)
    let pgp_gut = pgp_efflux_factor(drug.is_pgp_substrate, state.c_gut)
    let pgp_brain = pgp_efflux_factor(drug.is_pgp_substrate, state.c_brain)
    let oatp_liver = oatp_uptake_factor(drug.is_oatp_substrate, state.c_venous)
    let oct_kidney = oct_uptake_factor(drug.is_oct_substrate, state.c_venous)
    
    let cl_h = well_stirred_cl(cl.cl_hepatic_int, flow.q_liver + flow.q_gut, drug.fu)
    
    let dc_liver = (flow.q_liver * c_art + flow.q_gut * state.c_gut / kp.kp_gut - (flow.q_liver + flow.q_gut) * state.c_liver / kp.kp_liver) / vol.v_liver
    let dc_liver_met = cl_h * state.c_liver * drug.fu / vol.v_liver / pgp_liver * oatp_liver
    let dc_liver_final = dc_liver - dc_liver_met
    
    let dc_kidney = (flow.q_kidney * (c_art - state.c_kidney / kp.kp_kidney)) / vol.v_kidney
    let dc_kidney_excr = cl.cl_renal * state.c_kidney * drug.fu / vol.v_kidney * oct_kidney
    let dc_kidney_final = dc_kidney - dc_kidney_excr
    
    let absorption = abs.ka * state.a_gut_lumen * abs.fa
    let dc_gut = (flow.q_gut * (c_art - state.c_gut / kp.kp_gut)) / vol.v_gut + absorption / vol.v_gut / pgp_gut
    
    let dc_muscle = (flow.q_muscle * (c_art - state.c_muscle / kp.kp_muscle)) / vol.v_muscle
    let dc_adipose = (flow.q_adipose * (c_art - state.c_adipose / kp.kp_adipose)) / vol.v_adipose
    let dc_brain = (flow.q_brain * (c_art - state.c_brain / kp.kp_brain)) / vol.v_brain / pgp_brain
    let dc_heart = (flow.q_heart * (c_art - state.c_heart / kp.kp_heart)) / vol.v_heart
    let dc_skin = (flow.q_skin * (c_art - state.c_skin / kp.kp_skin)) / vol.v_skin
    let dc_rest = (flow.q_rest * (c_art - state.c_rest / kp.kp_rest)) / vol.v_rest
    
    let venous_return = flow.q_liver * state.c_liver / kp.kp_liver + flow.q_kidney * state.c_kidney / kp.kp_kidney + flow.q_muscle * state.c_muscle / kp.kp_muscle + flow.q_adipose * state.c_adipose / kp.kp_adipose + flow.q_brain * state.c_brain / kp.kp_brain + flow.q_heart * state.c_heart / kp.kp_heart + flow.q_skin * state.c_skin / kp.kp_skin + flow.q_rest * state.c_rest / kp.kp_rest
    let dc_venous = (venous_return - q_total * state.c_venous) / vol.v_blood
    
    let dc_lung = (q_total * (state.c_venous - state.c_lung / kp.kp_lung)) / vol.v_lung
    
    let da_gut = 0.0 - abs.ka * state.a_gut_lumen
    let da_met = cl_h * state.c_liver * drug.fu * oatp_liver / pgp_liver
    let da_excr = cl.cl_renal * state.c_kidney * drug.fu * oct_kidney
    
    return Derivatives {
        dc_venous: dc_venous,
        dc_arterial: dc_lung,
        dc_liver: dc_liver_final,
        dc_kidney: dc_kidney_final,
        dc_gut: dc_gut,
        dc_muscle: dc_muscle,
        dc_adipose: dc_adipose,
        dc_brain: dc_brain,
        dc_heart: dc_heart,
        dc_lung: dc_lung,
        dc_skin: dc_skin,
        dc_rest: dc_rest,
        da_gut_lumen: da_gut,
        da_metabolized: da_met,
        da_excreted: da_excr
    }
}

fn update_rbc_population(
    rbc: RBCPopulation,
    retic_input: f64,
    hemolysis_rate: f64,
    dt: f64
) -> RBCPopulation {
    let survival = 1.0 - hemolysis_rate * dt

    // Shift cells to older bins (aging) with survival
    let new_bin_11 = 0.0  // Oldest cells die
    let new_bin_10 = rbc.bin_10 * survival
    let new_bin_9 = rbc.bin_9 * survival
    let new_bin_8 = rbc.bin_8 * survival
    let new_bin_7 = rbc.bin_7 * survival
    let new_bin_6 = rbc.bin_6 * survival
    let new_bin_5 = rbc.bin_5 * survival
    let new_bin_4 = rbc.bin_4 * survival
    let new_bin_3 = rbc.bin_3 * survival
    let new_bin_2 = rbc.bin_2 * survival
    let new_bin_1 = rbc.bin_1 * survival
    let new_bin_0 = retic_input * dt

    // Calculate total
    let total = new_bin_0 + new_bin_1 + new_bin_2 + new_bin_3 + new_bin_4 + new_bin_5 +
                new_bin_6 + new_bin_7 + new_bin_8 + new_bin_9 + new_bin_10 + new_bin_11

    // Reticulocytes = youngest 2 bins
    let retics = new_bin_0 + new_bin_1

    // Mean age calculation (center of each 10-day bin)
    let age_sum = new_bin_0 * 5.0 + new_bin_1 * 15.0 + new_bin_2 * 25.0 + new_bin_3 * 35.0 +
                  new_bin_4 * 45.0 + new_bin_5 * 55.0 + new_bin_6 * 65.0 + new_bin_7 * 75.0 +
                  new_bin_8 * 85.0 + new_bin_9 * 95.0 + new_bin_10 * 105.0 + new_bin_11 * 115.0

    let mean_age = if total > 0.0 { age_sum / total } else { 60.0 }

    return RBCPopulation {
        bin_0: new_bin_0,
        bin_1: new_bin_1,
        bin_2: new_bin_2,
        bin_3: new_bin_3,
        bin_4: new_bin_4,
        bin_5: new_bin_5,
        bin_6: new_bin_6,
        bin_7: new_bin_7,
        bin_8: new_bin_8,
        bin_9: new_bin_9,
        bin_10: new_bin_10,
        bin_11: new_bin_11,
        total_rbc: total,
        reticulocytes: retics,
        mean_age_days: mean_age
    }
}

fn init_params(p: &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div {
    p[0] = 1.0 / 1000000000.0     // D_eff = 1e-9
    p[1] = 3.9 / 1000000.0        // dx = 3.9e-6
    p[2] = 0.0                     // k_release = 0
    p[3] = 3.0 / 1000.0           // CL_site = 0.003
    p[4] = 75.0 / 1000.0          // fu = 0.075
    p[5] = 5.0                     // Kp
    p[6] = 10.0                    // C_portal
    p[7] = 8.0                     // C_ha
    p[8] = 1.2                     // f_heart
    p[9] = 0.05                    // A_portal
    p[10] = 0.30                   // A_ha
    p[11] = 0.785                  // phi_ha
    p[12] = 0.0                    // C_tissue
    p[13] = 3.0 / 10000.0         // v_blood = 3e-4
    p[14] = 1.0                    // zonation (uniform)
    // [15]=Vmax, [16]=Km: Michaelis-Menten clearance
    // Linear limit: Vmax/Km = CL_site * fu = 0.000225
    // Default: Km=10 (moderate saturation at C_portal=10)
    let cl_lin = p[3] * p[4]
    p[16] = 10.0                    // Km (ng/mL) — at C_portal, C/Km = 1
    p[15] = cl_lin * p[16]          // Vmax = CL_linear * Km = 0.00225
}

fn run_three_doors(km_val: f64, cl_site_val: f64, dt: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic, IO {
    let warmup: i64 = 20
    let meas: i64 = 5

    // Scenario 1: Uniform + Steady
    var p1: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    init_params(&!p1)
    p1[3] = cl_site_val
    p1[9] = 0.0
    p1[10] = 0.0
    p1[14] = 1.0
    p1[16] = km_val
    let cl_lin = cl_site_val * p1[4]
    p1[15] = cl_lin * km_val
    let c_uu = run_scenario(&p1, dt, warmup, meas)

    // Scenario 2: Zonated + Steady
    var p2: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    init_params(&!p2)
    p2[3] = cl_site_val
    p2[9] = 0.0
    p2[10] = 0.0
    p2[14] = 5.0
    p2[16] = km_val
    p2[15] = cl_lin * km_val
    let c_zu = run_scenario(&p2, dt, warmup, meas)

    // Scenario 3: Uniform + Pulsatile
    var p3: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    init_params(&!p3)
    p3[3] = cl_site_val
    p3[14] = 1.0
    p3[16] = km_val
    p3[15] = cl_lin * km_val
    let c_up = run_scenario(&p3, dt, warmup, meas)

    // Scenario 4: Zonated + Pulsatile
    var p4: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    init_params(&!p4)
    p4[3] = cl_site_val
    p4[14] = 5.0
    p4[16] = km_val
    p4[15] = cl_lin * km_val
    let c_zp = run_scenario(&p4, dt, warmup, meas)

    // Reference: uniform steady outflow
    let ref_c = c_uu

    // Three doors (% of reference)
    let d1 = c_zu - c_uu
    let d2 = c_up - c_uu
    let d3 = c_zp - c_zu - c_up + c_uu
    let d1p = 100.0 * d1 / ref_c
    let d2p = 100.0 * d2 / ref_c
    let d3p = 100.0 * d3 / ref_c

    println("  Km (ng/mL):")
    println(km_val)
    println("  C/Km ratio:")
    let p6 = p1[6]
    println(p6 / km_val)
    println("  Vmax:")
    println(cl_lin * km_val)
    println("  Uniform+Steady outflow:")
    println(c_uu)
    println("  Door 1 (zonation %):")
    println(d1p)
    println("  Door 2 (pulsatility %):")
    println(d2p)
    println("  Door 3 (interaction %):")
    println(d3p)
    println("")
}

fn build_molecule_dataset() -> Dataset with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var ds = Dataset {
        features: [0.0; 2048],
        labels:   [0; 256],
        n_samples:  10,
        n_features:  3,
        n_classes:   2,
    }

    // Row 0: H₂ equilibrium — stable (label 0)
    ds.features[0]  =  0.00   // bond length deviation
    ds.features[1]  =  0.00   // angle deviation
    ds.features[2]  =  0.00   // energy above min
    ds.labels[0]    =  0

    // Row 1: slightly stretched — stable
    ds.features[3]  =  0.05
    ds.features[4]  =  0.02
    ds.features[5]  =  0.03
    ds.labels[1]    =  0

    // Row 2: compressed geometry — stable
    ds.features[6]  = -0.04
    ds.features[7]  = -0.01
    ds.features[8]  =  0.02
    ds.labels[2]    =  0

    // Row 3: moderate stretch — stable
    ds.features[9]  =  0.10
    ds.features[10] =  0.05
    ds.features[11] =  0.08
    ds.labels[3]    =  0

    // Row 4: highly compressed — borderline stable
    ds.features[12] = -0.15
    ds.features[13] = -0.10
    ds.features[14] =  0.15
    ds.labels[4]    =  0

    // Row 5: heavily stretched — unstable (label 1)
    ds.features[15] =  0.50
    ds.features[16] =  0.30
    ds.features[17] =  0.80
    ds.labels[5]    =  1

    // Row 6: very compressed — unstable
    ds.features[18] = -0.60
    ds.features[19] = -0.40
    ds.features[20] =  0.90
    ds.labels[6]    =  1

    // Row 7: extreme stretch — unstable
    ds.features[21] =  0.80
    ds.features[22] =  0.60
    ds.features[23] =  1.20
    ds.labels[7]    =  1

    // Row 8: extreme compression — unstable
    ds.features[24] = -0.90
    ds.features[25] = -0.70
    ds.features[26] =  1.50
    ds.labels[8]    =  1

    // Row 9: dissociating — unstable
    ds.features[27] =  1.50
    ds.features[28] =  1.00
    ds.features[29] =  2.00
    ds.labels[9]    =  1

    return ds
}

    }

fn run_tests() -> i64 with IO {
    print("======================================================================\n")
    print("  GUM H.1 End-Gauge Calibration\n")
    print("  JCGM 100:2008 Example H.1\n")
    print("  Pure x86-64 native ELF — self-hosted compiler\n")
    print("======================================================================\n")
    print("\n")

    // Input quantities (Table H.1)
    let L_nm = 50000000.0
    let alpha_s = 0.0000115

    // d: calibration measurement
    let d_v = 215.0
    let d_u = 5.8
    // d_l: deviation from nominal
    let d_l_v = 0.0
    let d_l_u = 25.0
    // delta_alpha: thermal expansion coefficient difference
    let da_v = 0.0
    let da_u = 0.00000115
    // theta: temperature deviation
    let th_v = 0.0 - 0.1
    let th_u = 0.41
    // delta_theta: temperature difference
    let dth_v = 0.0
    let dth_u = 0.029

    // ---- TEST 1: Step-by-step GUM propagation ----
    print("TEST 1: Step-by-step GUM propagation\n\n")

    // additive = d + d_l (values add, uncertainties combine in quadrature)
    let add_v = d_v + d_l_v
    let add_u = sqrt_f64(d_u * d_u + d_l_u * d_l_u)
    print("  d + d_l value (nm): ")
    print_float(add_v)
    print("\n")
    print("  d + d_l uncertainty (nm): ")
    print_float(add_u)
    print("\n")

    // L * delta_alpha (scale uncertainty)
    let Lda_v = da_v * L_nm
    let Lda_u = da_u * L_nm

    // thermal_1 = L_dalpha * theta (multiply uncertain quantities)
    let t1_v = Lda_v * th_v
    let t1_u = sqrt_f64(th_v * th_v * Lda_u * Lda_u + Lda_v * Lda_v * th_u * th_u)
    print("  L*delta_alpha*theta value (nm): ")
    print_float(t1_v)
    print("\n")
    print("  L*delta_alpha*theta unc (nm): ")
    print_float(t1_u)
    print("\n")

    // thermal_2 = L * alpha_s * delta_theta (scale)
    let L_alpha_s = L_nm * alpha_s
    let t2_v = dth_v * L_alpha_s
    let t2_u = abs_f64(L_alpha_s) * dth_u
    print("  L*alpha_s*delta_theta value (nm): ")
    print_float(t2_v)
    print("\n")
    print("  L*alpha_s*delta_theta unc (nm): ")
    print_float(t2_u)
    print("\n")

    // result = additive - thermal_1 - thermal_2
    let r_v = add_v - t1_v - t2_v
    let r_u = sqrt_f64(add_u * add_u + t1_u * t1_u + t2_u * t2_u)

    print("\n  Combined result:\n")
    print("    l_S - l_N (nm): ")
    print_float(r_v)
    print("\n")
    print("    u_c (nm): ")
    print_float(r_u)
    print("\n")

    // ---- TEST 2: Analytical sensitivity coefficient verification ----
    print("\nTEST 2: Analytical sensitivity coefficient verification\n")

    let c_d = 1.0
    let c_dl = 1.0
    let c_da = 0.0 - L_nm * th_v
    let c_th = 0.0 - L_nm * da_v
    let c_dth = 0.0 - L_alpha_s

    let u_c_sq = c_d * c_d * d_u * d_u + c_dl * c_dl * d_l_u * d_l_u + c_da * c_da * da_u * da_u + c_th * c_th * th_u * th_u + c_dth * c_dth * dth_u * dth_u
    let u_c = sqrt_f64(u_c_sq)

    print("  Analytical u_c (nm): ")
    print_float(u_c)
    print("\n")

    let err_uc = abs_f64(r_u - u_c) / u_c
    print("  Relative error (step vs analytical): ")
    print_float(err_uc)
    print("\n")

    if err_uc > 0.01 {
        print("FAIL: Step-by-step diverges from analytical (>1%)\n")
        return 1
    }
    print("  [PASS] Step-by-step matches analytical within 1%\n")

    // ---- TEST 3: Comparison with published GUM H.1 values ----
    print("\nTEST 3: Comparison with published GUM H.1 values\n")

    let gum_uc = 32.0
    let gum_U = 67.0

    let err_vs_gum = abs_f64(u_c - gum_uc) / gum_uc
    print("  Our u_c: ")
    print_float(u_c)
    print("\n")
    print("  GUM u_c: 32.0\n")
    print("  Relative difference: ")
    print_float(err_vs_gum)
    print("\n")

    if err_vs_gum > 0.05 {
        print("FAIL: u_c deviates >5% from published GUM value\n")
        return 2
    }
    print("  [PASS] u_c within 5% of GUM published value\n")

    // ---- TEST 4: Welch-Satterthwaite effective DoF ----
    print("\nTEST 4: Welch-Satterthwaite effective DoF\n")

    let ci_d = abs_f64(c_d) * d_u
    let ci_dl = abs_f64(c_dl) * d_l_u
    let ci_da = abs_f64(c_da) * da_u
    let ci_th = abs_f64(c_th) * th_u
    let ci_dth = abs_f64(c_dth) * dth_u

    // DoFs from GUM Table H.1
    let nu_d = 24.0
    let nu_dl = 18.0
    let nu_da = 50.0
    let nu_th = 2.0
    let nu_dth = 2.0

    let u_c4 = pow4(u_c)
    let ws_denom = pow4(ci_d) / nu_d + pow4(ci_dl) / nu_dl + pow4(ci_da) / nu_da + pow4(ci_th) / nu_th + pow4(ci_dth) / nu_dth
    let nu_eff = u_c4 / ws_denom

    print("  nu_eff: ")
    print_float(nu_eff)
    print("\n")
    print("  GUM nu_eff: 16\n")

    if nu_eff < 10.0 {
        print("FAIL: nu_eff too low (<10)\n")
        return 3
    }
    if nu_eff > 25.0 {
        print("FAIL: nu_eff too high (>25)\n")
        return 4
    }
    print("  [PASS] nu_eff in reasonable range (10-25)\n")

    // ---- TEST 5: Expanded uncertainty ----
    print("\nTEST 5: Expanded uncertainty\n")

    var nu_int = 16
    if nu_eff < 16.0 { nu_int = 15 }
    if nu_eff < 15.0 { nu_int = 14 }
    if nu_eff < 14.0 { nu_int = 13 }
    if nu_eff < 13.0 { nu_int = 12 }
    if nu_eff < 12.0 { nu_int = 11 }
    if nu_eff < 11.0 { nu_int = 10 }
    if nu_eff > 17.0 { nu_int = 17 }
    if nu_eff > 18.0 { nu_int = 18 }

    let k = t_95_lookup(nu_int)
    let U = k * u_c

    print("  nu_int (truncated): ")
    print_int(nu_int)
    print("\n")
    print("  k (95% coverage): ")
    print_float(k)
    print("\n")
    print("  U = k * u_c (nm): ")
    print_float(U)
    print("\n")
    print("  GUM U: 67.0 nm\n")

    let err_U = abs_f64(U - gum_U) / gum_U
    print("  Relative difference: ")
    print_float(err_U)
    print("\n")

    if err_U > 0.10 {
        print("FAIL: Expanded uncertainty deviates >10% from GUM\n")
        return 5
    }
    print("  [PASS] Expanded uncertainty within 10% of GUM\n")

    // ---- TEST 6: Contribution breakdown verification ----
    print("\nTEST 6: Contribution breakdown verification\n")

    let exp_d = 5.8
    if abs_f64(ci_d - exp_d) > 0.01 {
        print("FAIL: d contribution incorrect\n")
        return 6
    }
    print("  [PASS] |c_d * u_d| = 5.8 nm\n")

    let exp_dl = 25.0
    if abs_f64(ci_dl - exp_dl) > 0.01 {
        print("FAIL: d_l contribution incorrect\n")
        return 7
    }
    print("  [PASS] |c_dl * u_dl| = 25.0 nm\n")

    let exp_da = 5.75
    if abs_f64(ci_da - exp_da) > 0.1 {
        print("FAIL: delta_alpha contribution incorrect\n")
        return 8
    }
    print("  [PASS] |c_dalpha * u_dalpha| ~ 5.75 nm\n")

    let exp_dth = 16.675
    if abs_f64(ci_dth - exp_dth) > 0.01 {
        print("FAIL: delta_theta contribution incorrect\n")
        return 9
    }
    print("  [PASS] |c_dtheta * u_dtheta| = 16.675 nm\n")

    // ---- SUMMARY ----
    print("\n======================================================================\n")
    print("  GUM H.1 END-GAUGE CALIBRATION — SUMMARY\n")
    print("======================================================================\n")
    print("  [PASS] Step-by-step propagation matches analytical (<1%)\n")
    print("  [PASS] u_c within 5% of published GUM value (32 nm)\n")
    print("  [PASS] Welch-Satterthwaite nu_eff in range (10-25)\n")
    print("  [PASS] Expanded uncertainty within 10% of GUM (67 nm)\n")
    print("  [PASS] All individual contributions verified\n")
    print("\n")
    print("  Sounio u_c: ")
    print_float(u_c)
    print("\n")
    print("  GUM published u_c: 32 nm\n")
    print("  Sounio U: ")
    print_float(U)
    print("\n")
    print("  GUM published U: 67 nm\n")
    print("\n")
    print("  Reference: JCGM 100:2008 (GUM) Section H.1\n")
    print("  All 6 tests match GUM ISO/IEC Guide 98-3\n")
    print("======================================================================\n")

    return 0
}

fn mcmc_split_rhat(chain: &MCMCChain) -> f64 {
    if chain.n_stored < 10 { return 2.0 }
    let half = chain.n_stored / 2
    let n = half as f64

    var sum1: f64 = 0.0
    var sum2: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < half {
        sum1 = sum1 + chain.samples[i]
        sum2 = sum2 + chain.samples[i + half]
        i = i + 1
    }
    let mean1 = sum1 / n
    let mean2 = sum2 / n

    var var1: f64 = 0.0
    var var2: f64 = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < half {
        let d1 = chain.samples[i] - mean1
        let d2 = chain.samples[i + half] - mean2
        var1 = var1 + d1 * d1
        var2 = var2 + d2 * d2
        i = i + 1
    }
    var1 = var1 / (n - 1.0)
    var2 = var2 / (n - 1.0)

    let W = (var1 + var2) / 2.0
    let grand_mean = (mean1 + mean2) / 2.0
    let dm1 = mean1 - grand_mean
    let dm2 = mean2 - grand_mean
    let B = n * (dm1 * dm1 + dm2 * dm2)
    if W < 1.0e-30 { return 1.0 }
    let var_plus = (n - 1.0) / n * W + B / n
    return sqrt_f64(var_plus / W)
}

                  coarse: &![f64; 4096]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nx_c = nx_f / 2
    let ny_c = ny_f / 2

    var j = 0
    while j <= nx_c {
        coarse[mg_idx2d(0, j, nx_c)] = fine[mg_idx2d(0, 2 * j, nx_f)]
        coarse[mg_idx2d(ny_c, j, nx_c)] = fine[mg_idx2d(ny_f, 2 * j, nx_f)]
        j = j + 1
    }
    var i = 0
    while i <= ny_c {
        coarse[mg_idx2d(i, 0, nx_c)] = fine[mg_idx2d(2 * i, 0, nx_f)]
        coarse[mg_idx2d(i, nx_c, nx_c)] = fine[mg_idx2d(2 * i, nx_f, nx_f)]
        i = i + 1
    }

    i = 1
    while i < ny_c {
        j = 1

            let fj = 2 * j

            let corners = fine[mg_idx2d(fi - 1, fj - 1, nx_f)]
                        + fine[mg_idx2d(fi - 1, fj + 1, nx_f)]
                        + fine[mg_idx2d(fi + 1, fj - 1, nx_f)]

                      + fine[mg_idx2d(fi, fj + 1, nx_f)]
                      + fine[mg_idx2d(fi - 1, fj, nx_f)]
                      + fine[mg_idx2d(fi + 1, fj, nx_f)]

            let center = fine[mg_idx2d(fi, fj, nx_f)]

            coarse[mg_idx2d(i, j, nx_c)] = corners / 16.0 + edges / 8.0 + center / 4.0

            j = j + 1

        i = i + 1
